get.summary: Consolidated Hub Status e Market Summary (Free)
get.description: Returns operational health and latest cached sample metrics across all 6 micro-services. Zero payment required.

200.description: Hub operational status and service catalog

get.summary: Foreign Exchange Rates (USD, EUR, GBP to BRL)
get.description: Returns real-time bid, ask, and daily percentage change for major fiat currencies to BRL. Requires x402 micropayment on Base.

get.summary: Spot Cryptocurrency Tickers
get.description: Returns spot prices in USD for BTC, ETH, SOL, USDC, and Base ecosystem tokens with 24h variation. Requires x402 micropayment on Base.

get.summary: DNS Records Resolution
get.description: Resolves authoritative DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME) for any valid domain name. Requires x402 micropayment on Base.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Target domain name to resolve (e.g., github.com)

get.summary: TLS/SSL Certificate Inspector
get.description: Performs a direct TLS handshake on port 443 to extract X.509 certificate validity, issuer, SANs, and remaining days. Requires x402 micropayment on Base.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: Hostname to inspect on port 443 (e.g., base.org)

get.summary: BGP ASN e IP Intelligence
get.description: Resolves Autonomous System Number (ASN), BGP organization, and country for a given IP address. Requires x402 micropayment on Base.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to lookup (default: caller IP)

200.description: ASN and routing metadata returned successfully

get.summary: Brazilian CEP e IBGE Municipal Code
get.description: Resolves public street, neighborhood, city, state, and official IBGE municipal code from an 8-digit Brazilian postal code (CEP). Requires x402 micropayment on Base.

200.description: Address and IBGE code returned successfully

get.summary: Brazilian Federal Revenue Corporate CNPJ Lookup
get.description: Retrieves public corporate registration data, status, CNAE economic activities, and address from Brazilian Receita Federal. Requires x402 micropayment of 0.0200 USDC on Base.

parameters.name: cnpj
parameters.description: 14-digit Brazilian CNPJ number (with or without formatting)

400.description: Invalid CNPJ format or checksum failure

get.summary: Official Brazilian Economic Indicators
get.description: Returns official interest rates (Selic target, Selic daily, CDI annual, CDI daily) and inflation metrics (IPCA 12-month accumulated and monthly) from the Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) and IBGE. Settled via x402 on Base (0.0050 USDC). Free teaser preview available on 402 challenge.

get.summary: Brazilian National Holidays and Banking Calendar
get.description: Returns full official schedule of Brazilian national holidays and non-banking days (ANBIMA and Febraban) for a given year (1900-2100). Computes mobile holidays deterministically using Meeus algorithm. Settled via x402 on Base (0.0050 USDC). Free teaser preview with next holiday available on 402 challenge.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Four-digit calendar year (e.g., 2026). Defaults to current year.

400.description: Invalid year parameter (must be between 1900 and 2100)

get.summary: ANBIMA Financial Workdays Calculator
get.description: Calculates Brazilian banking workdays according to official ANBIMA convention. Supports 3 operation modes: date range counting (exclusive start, inclusive end), maturity date projection (+/- N workdays), and single-date workday verification. Settled via x402 on Base (0.0050 USDC) or free in Sandbox mode.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Initial reference date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD) for interval counting mode.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Number of workdays to add (positive) or subtract (negative) for projection mode (max 5000).

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Single date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD) for single-date check mode.

400.description: Invalid date format, range or displacement exceeding limits

get.summary: Administrative Sanctions and Debarment (CEIS and CNEP)
get.description: Checks administrative sanctions, debarments, and temporary suspensions in the official CGU registries (CEIS and CNEP) for a Brazilian CNPJ.

get.summary: Simples Nacional and MEI Tax Status
get.description: Queries official opt-in and historical enrollment in Simples Nacional and SIMEI (MEI) special tax regimes from Federal Revenue.

200.description: Simples Nacional tax status retrieved successfully

get.summary: Compliance Score 360 and Entity Risk Assessment
get.description: Evaluates unified cadastral risk, legal sanity, tax regime, and active administrative sanctions for a Brazilian company, generating an integrity score from 0 to 100 with risk tier classification.

get.summary: Global Corporate Identity via GLEIF LEI (CC0 1.0 Public Domain)
get.description: Queries the official Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF) registry across 200+ jurisdictions. Price: 0.0200 USDC (4 Session Pass credits).

parameters.name: lei
parameters.description: 20-character ISO 17442 LEI code or legal entity name

200.description: Verified LEI corporate identity record with ECDSA oracle proof

get.summary: Global Sanctions (OFAC SDN / UN) & Web3 AML Wallet Inspector
get.description: Cross-checks 0x EVM wallets, LEI codes, or entity names against US Treasury OFAC SDN and UN Consolidated Lists, plus live Base Mainnet wallet telemetry. Price: 0.0200 USDC (4 Session Pass credits).

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: 0x EVM wallet address, LEI code, or entity name

200.description: Sanctions screening and Base Mainnet AML risk report

get.summary: M2M Cryptographic Timestamp & Proof-of-Existence
get.description: Generates a deterministic SHA-256 hash and issues a UTC timestamp certificate signed with the Grid402 Oracle secp256k1 private key. Price: 0.0050 USDC (1 Session Pass credit).

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Arbitrary string or 64-char SHA-256 hex digest to notarize

get.summary: World Financial Calendar (US/EU/UK/BR) & 30+ ECB FX Reference Rates
get.description: Returns exchange settlement holiday status for US (NYSE/Fed), EU (TARGET2), UK (LSE), or BR (B3/ANBIMA) plus 30+ official European Central Bank reference rates. Price: 0.0050 USDC (1 Session Pass credit).

200.description: Global market settlement calendar and 30+ ECB FX rates

get.summary: x402 Prepaid Session Pass Issuance & Free Balance Check
get.description: Issues a signed pass_g402_<id>_<hmac> token when paid via X-Payment (0.5000 USDC = 100 credits, 0.5000 USDC = 1,000 credits), or checks remaining credits for free via ?status=pass_g402_...

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Optional pass_g402_... token to inspect remaining credits for free

200.description: Issued session pass or active balance status

post.description: Verifies the ECDSA secp256k1 cryptographic signature and canonical SHA-256 data hash of a response payload previously emitted by the Grid402 Oracle. Stateless, zero-DB, memory execution in less than 1 ms. Max payload size 64 KB.

requestBody.description: Arbitrary Grid402 response JSON containing the _oracle_proof block

413.description: Payload exceeds maximum limit of 64 KB

get.summary: Stateless Oracle Proof Verification (Query Param)
get.description: Convenience GET endpoint accepting a URL-encoded JSON string in the payload query parameter.

get.description: Returns terms of service, liability limitations, and network parameters.
